title: Brazilian-Style Pao de Queijo
description: A traditional Brazilian cheese bread recipe with a crispy exterior and a soft, cheesy interior. Perfect as a snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: pao de queijo mix
ingredients.amount: 1 box (includes tapioca starch, coconut oil, and salt)

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine pao de queijo mix, de queijo cheese, umami seasoning blend, and brazilian cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and melted coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
Place the balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
While the cheese bread is baking, cook the prosciutto slices in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Once the cheese bread is done, remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm with crispy prosciutto slices on top.
